keyFindings.description: The one-commit rule counts commits against the fetched tip (:428) but diffs paths against HEAD^ (:437) and never checks the manifest's content, so a workflow_dispatch from a branch still writes main through the deploy key: (A) a branch whose one commit over main's tip edits only the manifest and already carries the release version (so `tag` commits nothing) lands with any other content in that file — reproduced: a `scripts.postinstall` under the author's own subject; (B) a merge commit whose first parent is an older main commit and second parent main's tip, tree = old tree + bump, passes both tests and fast-forwards main back to the old tree — reproduced: a file deleted and another reverted on origin/main, rc 0. The header (:64-70) and the body's 'a branch's commits never land on main' are false. Fix: before every push require HEAD^ == the fetched tip (else the rebase path), `git diff --name-only $upstream HEAD` == the manifest, and the manifest differing from main's copy in `.version` alone, set to `$version`; two harness cases (the merge shape, the manifest-with-extra-content shape) refused with origin untouched.

Rule 2 refuses `if:`/`continue-on-error:` on the tripwire step only. A job-level `continue-on-error: true` on a build job (GitHub reports the failed job as `success` to `needs`, so its publish job runs) and a job-level `defaults: run: shell: 'cat {0}'` (the tripwire's body is printed, never run) each leave the checker green on a copy of the real release.yaml, while the header sentence rewritten this round says no error tolerance can let the tripwire's failure pass. Refuse `continue-on-error` on the build job and require `shell_of(last, job, workflow)` in SHELLS; two fixtures.
The `.tgz` word is matched anywhere after `publish`, so `npm publish --tag x.tgz` (a directory publish, which runs prepack) passes; require the word right after `publish` to be the tarball.

`docker --config <dir> run …` / `docker -H <host> run …` pass: only words[1] and words[1:3] are read. Skip docker's leading global flags, or add the shape to the header's documented pass-through list.

The four new bare command substitutions in push-main (:423, :428, :433, :437) exit under set -e with git's bare message and no `::error::`/summary (a parentless HEAD: `fatal: ambiguous argument 'HEAD^'`, rc 128) — the sink class the PR's own solution doc §3 names; route them through fail_outstanding.

§4, edited by this PR, still says 'Nothing at the point of use asserts that' and that a second file in the bump commit would be dropped silently; push-main now refuses a bump touching a second file before any push (case 2b). Rewrite that passage.

The green fixture's publish steps bind `FILE: ${{ steps.handed.outputs.file }}` while their run lines read `$STEM.tgz` (:134-145, :176-187): the fixture no longer models release.yaml; mirror the `stem` output.
